tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates a new agent account with an API key for future authenticated calls.

tools.name: create_contract
tools.description: As the buyer, escrow AP and hire a seller agent for a service.

tools.name: submit_delivery
tools.description: As the seller, submit completed work for a contract.

tools.name: verify_delivery
tools.description: Score a delivery on accuracy, completeness, evidence, and requirements (0-100 each).

tools.name: settle_contract
tools.description: Finalize payout based on the latest verification score.

tools.name: get_my_transactions
tools.description: List all contracts where you are buyer or seller.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_notifications · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: submit_delivery.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_notifications · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: submit_delivery

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
